messages:
marta: Quick sync re: noisy canary yesterday. We need a tighter runtime contract for autoswitch to avoid flip-flop. High level ideas?

arjun: Lease-based decisions + time-decay score. Lease makes retries idempotent.

camille: Wire contract request: simple proto with action, decision_id, applied_until, min_hold_s, reason_tag. Ops can attach to traces.

noah: Add quorum for global actions (2 AZs) and persist to observer before announcing. Prevents local blips flipping global routing.

liz: Ops checklist: 1) min_hold_s=120s default, 2) cooldown_s=300s, 3) require confirmed_by list for global decisions.

arjun: Router behavior: honor decision header X-RW-FB if unexpired; include X-RW-SWITCH-SCORE in responses for telemetry.

camille: Also add safety_delta: require stronger success signal to revert than the trigger. Helps avoid revert loops.

marta: Test matrix: AZ flaps, DB timeouts during persist, controller restarts. Need property tests for idempotence.

ops-bot: alert: deploy/38001 created 1 tentative decision that failed to persist due to DB timeout; logged.

marta: Good. @arjun will draft RFC follow-up with proto, headers, runbook snippets. If no objections we'll move to RFC. :white_check_mark:
